text: dsh-usage-monitor（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Settings 中查看会话 token 用量、请求数和估算费用。Host 端读取会话日志并折叠每步 usage，按日期、提供商、模型和 workspace 汇总，再通过 RPC 将快照交给 Web 页面。页面提供日期范围、token 或请求指标、按提供商/模型/workspace 分组，以及日/周趋势图和明细卡片。适合想了解 DSH 会话用量构成与费用估算的用户；无需额外 API key，需由 DSH 提供会话、workspace 与 connection 服务。

dsh-usage-monitor (DSH Web plugin): view session tokens, requests, and estimated costs in Settings. It aggregates usage by date, provider, model, and workspace, with date filters, breakdowns, and daily or weekly charts. Requires DSH session, workspace, and connection services; no extra API key.
想在 DSH 里查看不同会话用了多少 token。
有没有办法按模型或提供商拆分我的 DSH 用量？
我想看看每天或每周的请求和 token 趋势。
能不能按 workspace 对比会话的用量？
想查看输出 token、缓存命中比例和估算费用。
How can I see token usage across my DSH sessions?
Show my usage broken down by model, provider, or workspace.
Can I compare cached input and output token totals over a chosen date range?
I want daily and weekly charts for requests and tokens.
dsh-usage-monitor 的功能「summary」：按日期范围汇总 token、请求数、输出 token、缓存输入比例和有价格数据时的估算费用。
dsh-usage-monitor 的功能「breakdown」：在 Settings 用量页面按提供商、模型或 workspace 查看汇总，并切换 token 或请求指标。
dsh-usage-monitor 的功能「trend」：以日或周粒度查看用量堆叠趋势图，并通过图表交互查看数据。
dsh-usage-monitor 的功能「session-fold」：从 session 日志折叠模型步骤 usage，同一 turn/step 的较新样本替换旧样本以避免重复计数。
dsh-usage-monitor 的功能「estimate」：根据内置定价对有价格信息的请求估算费用，并区分已定价与未定价请求。

dsh-usage-monitor README · dsh-usage-monitor：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Usage dashboard for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It folds provider-reported token usage out of session logs and charts it in Settings.

dsh-usage-monitor README · Compatibility：Host DSH peers and development dependencies use the open lower-bound range `>=0.1.7-alpha.2`. The lockfile resolves DSH `0.1.7-rc.2` packages and Cordis `4.0.4`. Optional peers let the plugin remain loadable outside the supported set.

`package.json#dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` records DSH `0.1.7-alpha.2`, `0.1.7-rc.1`, and `0.1.7-rc.2` as compatible evidence, not an allowlist. Unknown newer Hosts warn once and keep the normal mount path. Only a reproduced failure is blocklisted.

dsh-usage-monitor README · What it shows：- Tokens, requests, output tokens, and cache-hit rate
- Stacked chart with Metric (token / request), By (provider / model / workspace), Group (day / week)
- Week, month, and custom ranges
- A responsive overview with a full-width token summary, compact secondary metrics, a stacked chart, and token-share cards that follow the current By grouping
- On narrow screens, the cards collapse to one column and the chart legend scrolls horizontally

dsh-usage-monitor README · What it shows：Escape closes an open Metric, By, or Group menu and restores focus to its trigger. With no menu open, Escape remains available to the Settings dialog.

Subscription quotas are not fetched.

dsh-usage-monitor README · Installation：Host development dependencies resolve to the rc.2 package set; see Compatibility. Install from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add --force https://github.com/NOirBRight/dsh-usage-monitor/releases/latest/download/dsh-usage-monitor-0.2.20.tgz
dsh web
```

The repository tracks release-ready lib artifacts, so GitHub installation needs no build-script allowlist. A source checkout can use a link installation after running `pnpm run build`.

Then open **Settings → Usage**.

dsh-usage-monitor README · Data：Reads live and persisted logs through the public `ctx.sessionQuery.readSession` API; `sessionPersistence.list` supplies cache revisions only. The usage RPC uses the authenticated `/api/plugin-rpc/usage-monitor` Fetch route. It does not inspect private persistence methods or session file paths. Unreadable sessions are omitted; only folded usage aggregates are returned.

dsh-usage-monitor README · Release：`pnpm run check` runs the full gate in order: unit tests, TypeScript typecheck, deterministic build-parity (clean temp build vs tracked `lib/`), package build, and a real `npm pack` + immutable `fixtures/rc1-0.1.7` validation + offline install + Host/client import smoke. The pack check reads only the repository-owned 0.1.7-rc.1 manifest/tarballs, verifies the official tag/commit and registry integrity, preserves versioned parent edges, and uses a fresh pnpm consumer with an invalid registry, offline/no-scripts/no-audit/no-fund settings, empty `NODE_PATH`, and scoped local-tarball overrides; it uses neither `--legacy-peer-deps` nor omit/force bypasses. The owner archive is written only below the prefixed temporary directory. It does not rewrite `lib/` before comparison, so a stale, missing or hand-edited artifact fails.

dsh-usage-monitor README · Release：For a tag, run `pnpm run check:strict` (the same test, typecheck, parity, build, and pack order with `PARITY_CHECK_HEAD=1`; it fails if the committed `lib/` still differs from the source — the v0.2.5 drift guard). Keep `src` as the source of truth and commit the rebuilt `lib/`.

The Settings → Usage nav icon is a DOM patch via `ctx.effect` + `MutationObserver` on `document.body`; see `src/client/nav-icon.ts` for the `ctx.effect` disposer and the accepted Alpha.4 DOM risk.

dsh-usage-monitor README · Release installation (Latest)：Session-log usage dashboard with responsive metric cards, charting, and provider shares. The published pack contains built Host/Client files only; it has no sibling-repository source, workstation path, link:, or workspace: dependency. Pack-check uses a frozen DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 graph; the development lockfile resolves DSH dependencies to 0.1.7-rc.2.

Latest installation (the URL never contains a version):

dsh-usage-monitor README · Release installation (Latest)：~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile web add --force \
  https://github.com/NOirBRight/dsh-usage-monitor/releases/latest/download/dsh-usage-monitor-0.2.20.tgz
~~~

Fixed-version installation:

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile web add --force \
  https://github.com/NOirBRight/dsh-usage-monitor/releases/download/v0.2.20/dsh-usage-monitor-0.2.20.tgz
~~~

Update, uninstall, and verify:

~~~sh

dsh-usage-monitor README · Update to the latest Release：dsh plugin --profile web add --force \
  https://github.com/NOirBRight/dsh-usage-monitor/releases/latest/download/dsh-usage-monitor-0.2.20.tgz
dsh-usage-monitor README · Verify the loaded version：dsh plugin --profile web list

dsh-usage-monitor README · Uninstall only this plugin：dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-usage-monitor
~~~

Configuration: use the plugin section in Settings for Web UI plugins, or the profile dsh.profile.bundles entry for Host-only plugins. Start with this README's minimal YAML/JSON example and provide credentials/backend addresses explicitly.

Rollback: rerun the fixed v0.2.19 command, verify the profile list, then restart the Web service once. Inspect journalctl --user -u dsh-web.service; never put a source checkout in the production profile.
